description: Structural and security requirements for all compiled auth middleware

rules.description: requireAuth must be an async function accepting (req, res?, next?) and returning the authenticated user or throwing AuthError
rules.check: export async function requireAuth(req, res?, next?)

rules.description: optionalAuth must accept the same signature as requireAuth but return null instead of throwing when no token
rules.check: export async function optionalAuth(req, res?, next?)

rules.description: Token must be extracted from Authorization header using 'Bearer ' prefix — not cookies or query params (unless spec says otherwise)
jwt.verify() must be used — never jwt.decode() alone (decode skips signature verification)
rules.check: absence of jwt.decode() without accompanying jwt.verify()

rules.description: Must export: AuthError (base), TokenExpiredError, InvalidTokenError, MissingTokenError
rules.check: export class AuthError, TokenExpiredError, InvalidTokenError, MissingTokenError

rules.description: When used as Express middleware, errors must be passed to next() or set res.status(401).json({ error: string })
console.log, console.error, logger.* must never include token values or raw credentials
rules.check: absence of console.log(token) or logger.error(err, { token })

rules.description: JWT_SECRET, API_KEY_SECRET and similar must be loaded from process.env — never hardcoded
rules.check: process.env.JWT_SECRET or equivalent secret broker call
